home.headline: Software engineering interview prep
home.sub: Pick a track, choose your level and practice multiple-choice questions with instant feedback and full explanations.
home.aboutText: DevTier is a free site for software engineering interview preparation. It has {questions} multiple-choice questions across {tracks} live tracks (frontend, backend and system design), split into Junior, Middle and Senior levels. Every question is available in English and Persian, and every answer comes with a full explanation so you learn the why, not just the answer.
home.step1Text: Frontend, backend or system design, depending on the role you are interviewing for.
home.step2Text: Junior for fundamentals, Middle for real-world scenarios and Senior for architecture and hard trade-offs.
home.step3Text: Pick an answer, see right away whether it is correct and read the explanation. Your progress is saved on this device.
home.faq1a: Developers preparing for technical interviews, from people looking for their first job to experienced engineers interviewing for senior roles.
home.faq2a: Frontend (HTML & CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and more), backend (Node.js, API design, databases, caching, security, message queues and more) and system design (scalability, load balancing, sharding, CAP, case studies and more). Algorithms, software engineering, DevOps and behavioral interviews are coming soon.
home.faq3q: Is DevTier free? Do I need an account?
home.faq3a: Yes, it is completely free and needs no sign-up. Your progress and bookmarks are stored only in your own browser.
home.faq4q: Are the questions in English or Persian?
home.faq4a: Both. You can switch languages at any time. The Persian text keeps technical terms in English, the way they are used at work.
home.faq5q: What is the difference between Junior, Middle and Senior?
home.faq5a: Junior questions test fundamentals, Middle questions focus on applied, real-world scenarios and Senior questions are about architecture, performance and trade-offs.
